card.name: "Has been reported" in C. difficile warning
card.fires_on: The word "reported" in the standard warning sentence "Clostridium difficile associated diarrhea (CDAD) has been reported with use of nearly all antibacterial agents". Rarely on other words such as "minutes" in "a few minutes".

modes.label: CDAD warning sentence
modes.description: The word "reported" right after "has been" in the C. difficile-associated diarrhea warning in antibiotic and PPI labels.
modes.example: Clostridium difficile associated diarrhea (CDAD) has been<< reported>> with use of nearly all antibacterial agents

modes.label: Stray web text
modes.description: An isolated hit on "minutes" in casual web text, unrelated to the label wording.
